name: ghostagram
description: Codex workflows for creating, inspecting, editing, laying out, and exporting collaborative Ghostagram diagrams through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Seven focused skills manage revision-safe collaborative Ghostagram sessions: open, create, inspect, edit, lay out, export, and close.
defaultPrompt: Use $ghostagram-open-session to join an existing collaborative diagram.
Use $ghostagram-create-diagram to create and open a new diagram.
Use $ghostagram-sync-diagram to inspect or synchronize diagram state.
Use $ghostagram-apply-operations to make a revision-safe diagram change.
Use $ghostagram-layout-diagram to preview or commit deterministic layout.
Use $ghostagram-export-svg to export a revision-pinned SVG.
Use $ghostagram-close-session to close the current collaboration session.
